subject: Cloud Master hub environment + lightning: SHIPPED and verified on production 2026-08-01. Storm safety worst-case delta 0.0735 vs WCAG 2.3.1 threshold 0.10 (27% margin), scoping 18/18, contrast 6/6 AA at peak flash, perf 60.2fps idle+pointer on 6x-throttled CPU, /houses/hub/** cache flipped max-age=3600 -> no-store. Chris BLOCKED round 1: storm-safety-probe.js sampled a fixed window at the CSS gradient centre (peak ALPHA) and under-reported the flash 4x; rewritten in 415e9306a to scan every 10x10 block for the true maximum. FOLLOW-UP still open: roll the environment to more hubs (ENV_HUBS allowlist currently gates cloud-master only).
